title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A hearty classic Italian meat sauce served over pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef|1 onion diced|3 cloves garlic minced|28 oz crushed tomatoes|2 tbsp tomato paste|1 tsp dried oregano|1 tsp dried basil|salt and pepper to taste|12 oz spaghetti|parmesan for serving
instructions: Brown beef in large pan over medium heat, drain fat. Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes. Stir in tomato paste then crushed tomatoes and herbs. Simmer 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti per package directions. Serve sauce over pasta with parmesan.

title: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
description: Easy weeknight chicken with roasted vegetables all on one pan
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs bone-in|2 cups broccoli florets|1 cup cherry tomatoes|3 tbsp olive oil|2 lemons juiced|4 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp dried thyme|1 tsp dried rosemary|salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Toss chicken and vegetables with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs. Spread on sheet pan. Roast 35-40 minutes until chicken reaches 165F internal temp.

title: Overnight Oats
description: No-cook make-ahead breakfast that's creamy and filling
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats|1 cup milk of choice|1/2 cup plain yogurt|2 tbsp chia seeds|2 tbsp maple syrup|1 tsp vanilla extract|1/2 cup fresh berries
instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar or container. Stir well. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours. Top with fresh berries before serving.

title: Black Bean Tacos
description: Quick and flavorful meatless tacos ready in 15 minutes
ingredients: 2 cans black beans drained|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp chili powder|1/2 tsp garlic powder|salt to taste|8 small corn tortillas|1 cup shredded cabbage|1 avocado sliced|1/2 cup salsa|lime wedges for serving
instructions: Heat beans in a skillet with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt. Warm tortillas. Build tacos with beans, cabbage, avocado, and salsa. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Classic creamy Caesar salad with grilled chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts|1 large head romaine lettuce chopped|1/2 cup caesar dressing|1/2 cup parmesan shaved|1 cup croutons|1 lemon juiced|black pepper to taste
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through. Let rest 5 minutes then slice. Toss romaine with dressing and parmesan. Top with chicken and croutons.
